source.title: Meeting regarding the development of technical regulations for the mapping and zoning of natural hazards

programme.title: Reducing Climate Change-Induced Risks in Georgia
partners: Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC)

meeting.purpose: review ongoing work toward a unified national approach for mapping and zoning natural hazards

interpretation_limits: The agency notice confirms that ongoing work and coordination were discussed; it does not prove that national mapping regulations were adopted or maps were published.
The notice names floods, avalanches, landslides and mudflows but gives no basin-by-basin or municipality-level risk ranking.
No hazard probabilities, exposed-population denominators, damage estimates, map scales, model validation or uncertainty ranges are provided.
The notice reports no operational warning issuance, delivery, receipt, comprehension, feasible-action or protective-action outcomes.
Programme partnership and meeting attendance do not constitute independent technical validation of future maps.
